subject: End-of-term settlement: staggered collection & invoice acceptance + VAT evidence
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acuityhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Shaw <peter.shaw@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: End-term invoice + split payment request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the product roadmap review last week. Finance is closing our books for the quarter and needs the final end-of-term statement from Redwood so we can settle by Nov 15. We received a consolidated PDF from your side but have two requests before we can process payment:

- Can Redwood accept a two-instalment payment for the final balance (60% now, 40% by Dec 15)?
- Because we are a Spain entity, we require EU VAT evidence for the December 2025–Oct 2026 service period. Our team needs a set of VAT registration proofs and the invoice broken down by VAT-applicable items.

Attached: Acuity_Final_Statement_20261028.pdf (requested copy).

We appreciate a short confirmation of acceptance and the wire instructions + any PO reference we should include.

Best,
Elena
Director, Finance Operations
Acuity Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-term invoice + split payment request

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers: yes, we can accept a staggered instalment schedule; and yes, we will provide the VAT evidence you need. Proposed plan below (happy to adjust):

1) Payment schedule
   - 60% of the outstanding balance due on receipt of signed acceptance (we can issue a final invoice for the 60% tranche today)
   - 40% due by 2026-12-15 (we will issue a follow-up invoice that references the initial tranche)

2) VAT / residency evidence
   - We'll provide: VAT registration certificate (Redwood EU entity), invoice line-item breakout showing VATable amounts, and our standard EU tax residency confirmation.

3) PO / wire details
   - Please confirm the PO number you want on the invoice. Once Vanessa confirms the wire instructions below, include them on your payment.

Vanessa — looping you in to confirm wire rails, invoice references (PO#), and whether Legal wants any holdback language for the second tranche. Grace — FYI on VAT artifacts; could you attach the EU VAT pack once available?

If that plan works for Acuity, I’ll generate the tranche invoice and mark the account for a follow-up collection note for Dec 8.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acuityhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-term invoice + split payment request

Hi Elena — glad we can be flexible. For the wire and remittance: please instruct your bank to reference PO ACU-71 and the invoice number we will send (I will populate the PO when Jordan confirms). Wire details (USD / EUR options):

- Redwood Inference — Euro Account (IBAN): GB33REDF00000000000001
- Redwood Inference — US Account (ACH/wire): 111122223333

We’ll issue the 60% tranche invoice as soon as you confirm the PO# and approve the staggered schedule. Note: for EU customers we sometimes require a 2% holdback on the final tranche pending VAT validation when cross-border residency records are still in flight. I don’t expect we’ll need that here, but legal asked me to flag it in case your VAT docs need time to clear.

Also attaching a short checklist of the VAT artifacts we typically need so collections can accept the second tranche without delay:
- Redwood EU VAT registration certificate
- Invoice line-item breakout
- Customer VAT registration (if reverse-charge applies)
- Signed acceptance or email confirmation to pair with the 60% tranche

Attachments: Acuity_VAT_Proofs.zip (placeholder — Jordan/Grace will upload Redwood artifacts to shared Drive).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: prepare VAT pack + tranche invoice

Vanessa / Grace — quick internal note before I close with Acuity:

- Vanessa: please draft the 60% invoice as a partial final invoice (reference ACU-71 and note "Tranche 1 of 2 — End-of-term settlement"). Put payment due on receipt.
- Grace: can you pull the Redwood EU VAT cert + invoice breakout for the 2025–2026 period and drop into the Drive link in the thread? Acuity will need a clear per-line VAT map.
- Also: check the account for any pre-existing credits that might offset the 60% tranche. I believe there is a small credit from Q2 usage refunds — if so, reflect that on the invoice.

I’ll ask Elena to confirm PO and then send the tranche invoice. Keep this one low-touch; Acuity prefers email confirmations over portal tickets.

-J

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acuityhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: End-term invoice + split payment request

Jordan / Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: Acuity accepts the two-instalment schedule. PO to use: ACU-PO-3549.

We will process the 60% tranche upon receipt of the tranche invoice today. Attached is a zip with our VAT registration and the signed acceptance for the EOT statement. Please include the PO reference and send the invoice to billing@acuityhealth.com.

Attachments: Acuity_VAT_Registration_Spain.pdf, Acuity_Signed_Acceptance.pdf

Elena
Director, Finance Operations
Acuity Health
